Class SimpleThreadPoolTaskExecutor

java.lang.Object
org.quartz.simpl.SimpleThreadPool
org.springframework.scheduling.quartz.SimpleThreadPoolTaskExecutor
All Implemented Interfaces:
Executor, ThreadPool, DisposableBean, InitializingBean, AsyncTaskExecutor, TaskExecutor, SchedulingTaskExecutor
public class SimpleThreadPoolTaskExecutor extends SimpleThreadPool implements AsyncTaskExecutor, SchedulingTaskExecutor, InitializingBean, DisposableBean
Subclass of Quartz's SimpleThreadPool that implements Spring's TaskExecutor interface and listens to Spring lifecycle callbacks.

可与 Quartz 调度器（指定为"taskExecutor"）和其他 TaskExecutor 用户共享，甚至可完全独立于 Quartz 调度器使用（作为普通的 TaskExecutor 后端）。

Since:
2.0
Author:
Jürgen Hoeller

      描述从接口复制：TaskExecutor
      Execute the given task.

    • submit

      public Future<?> submit(Runnable task)
      描述从接口复制：AsyncTaskExecutor
      Submit a Runnable task for execution, receiving a Future representing that task. The Future will return a null result upon completion.

      自 6.1 版本起，此方法具有默认实现，该实现委托给 TaskExecutor.execute(Runnable)。

      Specified by:
      `submit` 在接口 `AsyncTaskExecutor` 中
      Parameters:
      task - 要执行的 Runnable(永远不为 null)
      Returns:
      代表任务待完成状态的 Future

      描述从接口复制：AsyncTaskExecutor
